pages.title: How Health Changes
pages.text: Crops start at 100% health. Suitable temperature and hydration allow normal growth and gradually restore health; mild stress stops growth and gradually drains health.$(br2)Every check costs or restores 4%, and it takes 25 bad checks in a row to kill the crop.

pages.title: Fertilizer and Maturity
pages.text: While the farmland still holds the nutrient the crop needs, health recovers twice as fast.$(br2)Once a crop is mature its health stays at 100%: it no longer dies from health and only over-ripens as TFC normally does.$(br2)Jade can show the current health value; see the $(l:mechanics/crops)Crops chapter$() for how to plant them.

pages.title: Extreme Temperatures
pages.text: Temperatures more than 10°C beyond either limit cost 45% health per check instead of killing the crop immediately; it takes three such checks in a row to kill it.
